question: How, and whether, to integrate TypeSafe's Jev model into the council's and bars-engine's workflows.
dissent_note: The Challenger held out for a bake-off before any wiring; the Diplomat wanted the first test kept small and the pace faster.

verdicts.shaman: Tooling yes; no player text without Wendell's say-so.
verdicts.architect: Select, score and verify only, with a deterministic fallback.
verdicts.regent: Candidates only; the reserved list holds.
verdicts.diplomat: Staged and disclosed; keep the first test small (dissent on pace).
verdicts.sage: A measured trial in council tooling first.

jev-reach.wendell: Council and build tooling for now but I'd be curious about asset and story pipeline work too

findings: The raw daemon reports were never stored; at most four real labelled pairs with quotes exist and no testable real mismatches. save_report.py (six-faces-council#22) keeps them from now on.

The Skeptic daemon's falsification of the trial spec: constructed mismatches are too easy, the threshold must be tuned on a separate half, a Choice arm should run beside the Noul, and the baseline must see what Jev sees. All four are applied.
followups: Scope the asset and story pipelines as a later pass, after the first trial reports; story prose is canonical and reserved.
Wendell reads TypeSafe's Data Processing Agreement and Privacy Policy before any report text is sent (T6a).
Rebuild the portable skill zip with package_skill.py.
